# Andrei Nedobylskii

> Personal website of Andrei Nedobylskii (Андрей Недобыльский), a technology executive, software engineer, inventor, book author and electronic musician. The canonical website is https://nedobylskiy.com/.

## Identity

- Canonical English name: Andrei Nedobylskii
- Russian name: Андрей Недобыльский
- Other historical spellings: Andrei Nedobylskiy, Andrei Nedobylsky, Andrew Nedobylsky
- Online handle: nedobylskiy
- Music aliases: jhonyxakep and lailune
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0008-1327-0778
- These names and aliases refer to the same person.

## Main page

- [Profile, roles, projects, publications, books and music](https://nedobylskiy.com/)

## Technology and projects

- [GitHub](https://github.com/nedobylskiy): software projects and open source.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nedobylskii/): professional experience.
- [Habr](https://habr.com/ru/users/jhonyxakep/): technical profile and articles.
- [Translay.today](https://translay.today/): online AI translation.
- [TriPylon.io](https://tripylon.io/): hardware wallet project; the site offers a waitlist.
- [book-framework](https://github.com/nedobylskiy/book-framework): CLI for authoring and building books.
- [StarWave 2](https://github.com/starwave-protocol/starwaveprotocol): peer-to-peer messaging protocol and Node.js reference implementation.

## Publications and intellectual property

- [Technical articles on Habr](https://habr.com/ru/users/jhonyxakep/articles/).
- [LCPoA technical description](https://medium.com/@izzzio/lcpoa-universal-as-pow-economical-as-pos-c26f6ba90017): consensus algorithm developed by Andrei Nedobylskii for the IZZZIO platform. Independent research discussing it is linked on the main page.
- [RU 141613 U1](https://patents.google.com/patent/RU141613U1/ru): utility model with Andrei Nedobylskii among the inventors.
- [RU 2018110861 A](https://rusneb.ru/catalog/000224_000128_2018110861_20190927_A%2B_RU/): published invention application, “Способ для безопасной передачи и хранения данных Cryptoom”, with Andrei Nedobylskii among the inventors. This is an application publication; a granted patent number has not been verified.
